lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Before we continue, I need you to answer one question.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: That sentence has never improved my day.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: The coolant manifold has developed what the manual calls an exciting new geometry.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Is that engineering language for broken?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Charlie has not been within six decks of the reactor.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: That has never stopped me blaming Charlie before.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Either way, please stop touching switches while I am talking.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: I have moved my hands to a completely different set of switches.

options.line: Before we continue, Charlie did it.
